# Linha de comando

Todos os comandos que o `tyto` aceita: 10. `tyto --help` e `tyto <comando> --help` imprimem o mesmo texto no terminal.

::: info Ajuda em inglês
A ajuda da linha de comando existe só em inglês, e esta página a mostra como o terminal a imprime.
:::

## tyto render

render one brief into an output folder (the ADR 0011 contract)

```sh
tyto render [options] <brief>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<brief>` | path to the .brief file |

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-o, --out <dir>` | folder for the artifacts and result.json (obrigatória) |  |
| `--folder` | deliver into &lt;out>/&lt;brief-name>/ — artwork at the top, brief and result.json in editaveis/ |  |
| `--assets <dir>` | what relative asset paths resolve against (default: assets/ beside the brief, else the brief's folder) |  |
| `--templates <dir>` | folder holding one subfolder per template | `"templates"` |
| `--formats-file <path>` | the project's formats.yaml, the one place a size is written | `"formats.yaml"` |
| `-t, --template <name>` | template to use when the brief's frontmatter names none |  |
| `-f, --formats <ids>` | comma-separated format ids, when the brief's frontmatter lists none |  |
| `--types <kinds>` | comma-separated: png, jpeg, webp, svg, or a kind an installed exporter adds | `["png"]` |
| `--scale <n>` | device pixels per CSS pixel; 2 is the retina export |  |
| `--quality <n>` | encoder quality 1-100, for jpeg and webp only |  |
| `--concurrency <n>` | frames rastered at once (default 2) |  |
| `--json` | print a machine-readable document instead of prose |  |

## tyto watch

render every task dropped into &lt;folder>/inbox, forever

```sh
tyto watch [options] <folder>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<folder>` | workspace holding inbox/, outbox/ and done/ |

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--interval <ms>` | milliseconds between sweeps of the inbox (default 1000) |  |
| `--once` | handle what is in the inbox now and exit, instead of watching |  |
| `--templates <dir>` | folder holding one subfolder per template | `"templates"` |
| `--formats-file <path>` | the project's formats.yaml, the one place a size is written | `"formats.yaml"` |
| `-t, --template <name>` | template to use when the brief's frontmatter names none |  |
| `-f, --formats <ids>` | comma-separated format ids, when the brief's frontmatter lists none |  |
| `--types <kinds>` | comma-separated: png, jpeg, webp, svg, or a kind an installed exporter adds | `["png"]` |
| `--scale <n>` | device pixels per CSS pixel; 2 is the retina export |  |
| `--quality <n>` | encoder quality 1-100, for jpeg and webp only |  |
| `--concurrency <n>` | frames rastered at once (default 2) |  |
| `--json` | print a machine-readable document instead of prose |  |

## tyto template check

validate a template folder: its manifest, then its markup (a code body is named, not run)

```sh
tyto template check [options] <folder>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<folder>` | the templates/&lt;name>/ folder to check |

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | print a machine-readable document instead of prose |  |

## tyto template new

scaffold a template folder from docs/template-authoring.md

```sh
tyto template new [options] <name>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<name>` | the template name, also its folder name |

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out <dir>` | where the folder is created | `"templates"` |
| `--formats <ids>` | comma-separated format ids the template renders | `["grid"]` |

## tyto plugin list

list every plugin: name, version, origin, status and what it contributes

```sh
tyto plugin list [options]
```

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--active` | only the plugins a render would activate |  |
| `--json` | print a machine-readable document instead of prose |  |

## tyto plugin install

install a plugin from a folder, a git URL or an npm package name

```sh
tyto plugin install [options] <source>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<source>` | a folder, a git URL (git+https://…, …/repo.git) or an npm spec |

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-y, --yes` | approve its permissions without asking |  |

## tyto plugin new

scaffold a template-pack plugin from docs/plugin-authoring.md

```sh
tyto plugin new [options] <name>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<name>` | the plugin's name, also its folder's and its template's |

**Opções**

| Opção | O que faz | Padrão |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out <dir>` | where the plugin folder is created | `"."` |
| `--code` | a code template, built in the plugin's process, instead of markup |  |

## tyto plugin remove

delete an installed plugin and what was approved for it

```sh
tyto plugin remove [options] <name>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<name>` | the plugin's name, as tyto plugin list prints it |

## tyto plugin disable

keep a plugin installed and stop activating it

```sh
tyto plugin disable [options] <name>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<name>` | the plugin's name, as tyto plugin list prints it |

## tyto plugin enable

activate a disabled plugin again

```sh
tyto plugin enable [options] <name>
```

**Argumentos**

| Argumento | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| `<name>` | the plugin's name, as tyto plugin list prints it |
